# Healthgrades

> > Healthgrades is a comprehensive healthcare provider directory and ratings platform enabling patients to find doctors, hospitals, and urgent care facilities with reviews, quality awards, and insurance filtering.

Healthgrades aggregates patient reviews, clinical quality metrics, and specialty excellence awards across thousands of healthcare providers. The platform specializes in doctor search, hospital ratings, and quality benchmarking with awards recognizing top-performing facilities in cardiac care, obstetrics, patient safety, and overall clinical outcomes.

## Key Topics

- Doctor Search
- Hospital Ratings
- Patient Reviews
- Medical Specialties
- Quality Awards
- Insurance Search
- Telehealth Available
- Family Medicine
- Obstetrics & Gynecology
- Orthopedic Surgery
- Patient Safety Excellence
- Local Search
- Urgent Care
- Group Practices
- Clinical Outcomes

## Doctor Search & Discovery

- [Find a Doctor](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-doctor): Main doctor search interface by specialty, location, and medical conditions.
- [Specialty Directory](https://www.healthgrades.com/specialty-directory): Comprehensive medical specialty directory for browsing all doctor types.
- [Insurance Search](https://www.healthgrades.com/insurance-search): Search doctors by insurance provider including Aetna, Anthem, Ambetter.
- [Doctor Reviews](https://www.healthgrades.com/doctor-reviews): Patient doctor review submission and healthcare provider rating platform.

## Medical Specialty Directories

- [Family Practice Doctors](https://www.healthgrades.com/family-practice-directory): Family medicine and primary care physician directory with ratings.
- [Internal Medicine Doctors](https://www.healthgrades.com/internal-medicine-directory): Internal medicine physician directory with patient reviews and ratings.
- [Obstetricians & Gynecologists](https://www.healthgrades.com/obstetrics-gynecology-directory): OB/GYN specialist directory with ratings and LGBTQ-affirming care info.
- [Orthopedic Surgeons](https://www.healthgrades.com/orthopedic-surgery-directory): Orthopedic surgery specialist directory with ratings and joint care info.
- [Dentists](https://www.healthgrades.com/dentistry-general-directory): General dentistry directory with local dentist listings and reviews.

## Hospital & Facility Finder

- [Find a Hospital](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-hospital): Hospital finder with ratings and quality comparisons for San Jose area.
- [Urgent Care Clinics](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-an-urgent-care): Urgent care and walk-in clinic finder with locations and physicians.
- [Medical Group Practices](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-group-practice): Medical group practice directory with locations and affiliated providers.
- [Pharmacies](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-pharmacy): Pharmacy locator with addresses, phone numbers, and local search.

## Quality Awards & Hospital Ratings

- [America's Best Hospitals](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/americas-best-hospitals): America's Best Hospitals Awards recognizing top-quality care hospitals.
- [Hospital Ratings & Awards](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/hospital-ratings-awards): Hospital quality ratings and awards based on clinical outcomes.
- [Specialty Excellence Awards](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/specialty-excellence-americas-best-care): Specialty excellence awards for cardiac, spine, and critical care.
- [OB/GYN Excellence Awards](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/ob-gyn-care-excellence-awards): OB/GYN excellence awards for labor, delivery, and gynecologic care.
- [Outstanding Patient Experience Award](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/outstanding-patient-experience-award): Patient experience awards recognizing top 15% hospitals for satisfaction.

## Homepage & Core Services

- [Healthgrades Homepage](https://www.healthgrades.com): Healthgrades homepage with doctor search, reviews, and appointment booking.
